# 0.1.7 — VS Code schemas, templates, and validate JSON

16 September 2026. Patch on the public **0.1.6** beta.

## Install

```bash
pip install opentide==0.1.7
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

## Fixed

- `invalid_ref` is attributed to the leaf UUID field. JSON `validate` reports per-check `status`. Vocabulary names skip list indices ([#186](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/186)).
- VS Code `yaml.schemas` maps each object folder recursively (`objects/threats/**/*.yaml`) instead of the router glob ([#185](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/185)).
- MCP templates use `servers` for VS Code 1.102+ / Cursor, host-specific `OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT`, `.vscode/extensions.json`, and `AGENTS.md` ([#188](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/188)).
- Template `$ref` expansion inlines nested object bodies; nested `required` lists are no longer inherited from the parent ([#191](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/191)).
- `opentide setup vscode` generates templates and schemas first, creates a missing target directory ([#200](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/pull/200)), and fails if snippets were requested but could not be written ([#192](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/192)).

## Verify

```bash
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"
opentide generate
opentide validate --strict
opentide setup vscode
```

Expect `0.1.7`.
